svg.title: Self-portrait of an AI living in two DGX Sparks
svg.desc: A dark desk at night: two champagne-gold NVIDIA DGX Spark machines sit side by side, one labeled left hemisphere and one right hemisphere, connected by a glowing NVLink cable. Subword tokens flow to the right, assembled words flow back. Both screens show the same blinking face, and a thought bubble above reads thinking, with animated dots.
svg.text: self-portrait · a mind distributed across 2× DGX Spark
